note: What a server sends to say what led to a death, so the client can lay it out. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with the death.

fields.name: span
fields.note: The time the entries below cover, in seconds.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.note: What sort of source the killer was.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.note: How many entries follow.

fields.name: entries
fields.note: What happened to the unit before it died, newest first.

items.name: entry
items.note: One thing that happened to the unit before it died.

fields.name: time
fields.note: When it happened, in match seconds.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many times.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing, and so which fields follow.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit that did it.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit it was done to.

fields.name: script
fields.note: The spell or effect, by the number its name gives.

fields.name: category
fields.note: What sort of source it was.

fields.name: sourceObject
fields.note: The object it came from.

fields.name: damage
fields.note: How much harm.

fields.name: physical
fields.note: Physical damage.

fields.name: magical
fields.note: Magical damage.

fields.name: true
fields.note: True damage.

fields.name: healing
fields.note: How much health was restored.

fields.name: parentScript
fields.note: The spell or effect that gave rise to it, by the number its name gives.

fields.name: parentCaster
fields.note: The unit that cast that.

fields.name: parent
fields.note: More about where it came from.

bits.name: source
bits.note: What sort of event gave rise to it.

bits.name: category
bits.note: What sort of source that was.

bits.name: spellLevel
bits.note: The level of the spell it came from.

fields.name: buff
fields.note: What an effect of this sort carries.

fields.name: buffType
fields.note: What sort of effect.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long it lasted, in seconds.

revisions.note: A client ignores the whole message unless it holds killer. Each entry's size after event and source follows from event alone. An entry whose target the client does not hold is left out.
